about.heading: 1. What this is about
about.p1: The Partner recommends the nisd2 NIS 2 walkthrough to companies implementing their NIS2 obligations. When a recommended company signs a contract with nisd2, the Partner receives a commission.
about.p2: The Partner is under no obligation to recommend anyone. nisd2 decides freely whether to sign a contract with a recommended company.

offer.heading: 2. What the customer gets
offer.p1: The customer contracts directly with nisd2, under the terms published on nisd2.eu. The NIS 2 walkthrough costs {price} net a year, plus VAT, and includes:
offer.p2: If nisd2 changes the price or the scope, new contracts follow what is published on nisd2.eu at the time.

support.heading: 3. Support and access
support.p1: nisd2 looks after the customer itself. nisd2 answers questions by email to {email}, usually within two working days. The Partner owes the customer no support for nisd2.
support.p3: The Partner gets access to the NIS 2 walkthrough on nisd2.eu free of charge, for its own company, to get to know it and to demonstrate it: already before acceptance, and afterwards for the term of this agreement. Its use is governed by the terms and the data processing agreement published on nisd2.eu. This access does not cover looking after customers; each customer signs its own contract. When this agreement ends, the access ends. If it is not concluded, nisd2 may end the access.

commission.heading: 4. Commission
commission.p1: The Partner receives {percent} percent of every net payment nisd2 receives from a recommended customer, {period}.
commission.periodMonths: for the first {months} months of that customer's contract
commission.periodOngoing: for as long as that customer continues its contract with nisd2
commission.p2: Net payment means excluding VAT and after refunds. The claim arises once the payment has reached nisd2 and the customer can no longer ask for it back, so on a first order after the 30 days money back have run out.
commission.p3: nisd2 settles quarterly by self-billed credit note and pays within 15 days of the end of the quarter. For this, the Partner gives nisd2 its tax number or VAT ID. If the Partner charges VAT, statutory VAT is added. The credit note lists, per customer, the payments the commission is based on.

attribution.heading: 5. When a customer counts as recommended
attribution.p1: A customer counts as recommended if, before its first order, the Partner names it to nisd2 by email to {email}, with company and contact person, or the customer tells nisd2 in text form (email is enough) that the Partner recommended it.
attribution.p2: If the customer already was a nisd2 customer or was already in a documented conversation with nisd2 about an order, nisd2 tells the Partner within five working days. The customer then does not count as recommended.

independence.heading: 6. Independence
independence.p1: Both sides are independent businesses and act as traders (Unternehmer) under section 14 BGB. The Partner is not permanently engaged to broker deals, decides the kind and extent of its activity itself and bears its own costs. It has no authority to act for nisd2 and makes no statements in its name. No commercial agency relationship arises.
independence.p2: The Partner tells the customer that it receives a commission for the recommendation.

promotion.heading: 7. Promotion
promotion.p1: The Partner may name nisd2 and point to nisd2.eu. It promises the customer nothing about service or price that is not on nisd2.eu, and promotes only as the law allows, in particular without unlawful advertising by email or phone.

data.heading: 8. Data protection and confidentiality
data.p1: Each side is a separate controller under the GDPR for the contact details the parties exchange. The Partner passes a customer's details to nisd2 only with that customer's knowledge.
data.p2: The terms of this agreement are confidential. The Partner may tell the customer the amount of its commission.

term.heading: 9. Term and termination
term.p1: This agreement runs indefinitely. Either side may end it in text form (email is enough) with one month's notice to the end of a month. For customers who count as recommended by then, nisd2 keeps paying commission under section 4.

final.heading: 10. Final provisions
final.p1: For simple negligence, each side is liable only for breach of essential obligations, meaning those whose fulfilment makes carrying out this agreement possible in the first place and on which the other side may regularly rely, and only up to the foreseeable damage typical for this agreement. This does not apply to injury to life, body or health; otherwise the law applies.
final.p2: This agreement is not meant for lawyers, tax advisers or auditors, whose professional rules prohibit taking advantages for mediating orders.
final.p3: Changes must be made in text form. German law applies. The place of jurisdiction is {seat}, where both sides are merchants. If one provision is invalid, the rest remains valid.
final.p4: The agreement is concluded when the Partner accepts it on nisd2.eu with its name and email address. Both sides receive a confirmation with the full text by email.

about.title: nisd2 in brief
about.lead: What your clients get from us, who it is for, and what it does not include.
about.deliver1: The NIS 2 walkthrough: the obligations under NIS2 (Art. 21 NIS2, in Germany § 30 BSIG) as guided steps, each point explained in plain words.
about.deliver2: Pre-filled, not blank: where the BSI recommends a method, it is ready to use, such as the risk assessment under BSI standard 200-3. The company adopts it or decides otherwise.
about.deliver3: The walkthrough writes the documents from the answers. Management approves them in the app, with name and date.
about.deliver4: It stays current afterwards: deadlines, reminders and recurring points come back to management for approval.
about.deliver5: Security questionnaire for suppliers, export to PDF or CSV. Open source, no lock-in.
about.for1: Companies with 50 to 150 employees that fall under NIS2.
about.for2: No security department of their own: one person looks after IT next to their day job.
about.not1: No on-site consulting and no workshops. We answer questions by email or in a call.
about.not2: No certification and no audit. What the walkthrough produces is the company's own statement.
about.not3: No legal advice, and no binding ruling on whether a company falls under NIS2.
about.not4: No technical implementation: firewalls, backups, monitoring and updates stay with the company or its IT provider.
about.not5: Not the GDPR. The walkthrough covers NIS2.
about.split: In short: whoever wants to implement NIS2 themselves, with guidance, is right with us. Whoever needs on-site support, an audit or the technical implementation is right with a partner like you.
